# CHD acceptance package
This package is the repeatable acceptance trace for R31-012 and R31-013. It is a fixture-backed contract check, not a claim that a live gateway has been tested. The cards are **planned** at package revision `working-tree` until a real service run produces an artifact. A live run must record the commit (or image digest), UTC date, fixture digest, and output path in its report.

## Prerequisites and credential placeholders
- Python 3.11 or newer; no third-party package is required. - A built CHD service and a test DuckBrain namespace when running against a live deployment. The static fixture check can run without either. - Set these placeholders only in an untracked environment file or secret manager; never put values in the fixture:
```text CHD_VP_TOKEN_REF=<authorized VP credential reference> CHD_SCHEDULER_TOKEN_REF=<authorized scheduler callback credential reference> CHD_DIRECTOR_TOKEN_REF=<authorized director credential reference> CHD_DUCKBRAIN_NAMESPACE=chd-acceptance-<run-id> CHD_GATEWAY_URL=<isolated test gateway URL> ```
The expected records intentionally contain references, not token values.

## Static, repeatable procedure
Run from the repository root:
```sh python3 build-spec/acceptance/run_acceptance.py \ --fixture build-spec/acceptance/fixtures/records.json \ --cards build-spec/acceptance/cards.json \ --out build-spec/acceptance/artifacts/acceptance-report.json ```
Exit status 0 means every card's expected field predicates matched a fixture record and every card had a non-id-only assertion, command, evidence query and planned/run label. The command prints each evidence query and the matched record key. It does **not** claim live execution. `--live` is deliberately not implemented by this package: an adapter must be added only when the deployed API and credential-loading path are approved.
For a live execution, follow the same card order and replace each fixture record with a read-back query against the isolated namespace. Record the exact request command, response body, UTC timestamp, commit/image digest and failure injection result. A live artifact is valid only when its `execution` object has `mode: live`, `status: pass`, and all 17 cards have `status: run`.

## Failure injections and evidence boundaries
The live procedure must inject: a full gateway queue, a wrong-request report, a duplicate gateway POST, a duplicate report, a crash at the ack/link window, a lost bonded session, an unreachable transport, and a denied authorization call. The expected records in `records.json` show the resulting durable bodies. Counter/soak evidence is performance evidence only. It cannot substitute for cards marked `semantic`, `authorization`, `recovery`, or `owner-acceptance`; each of those categories has non-counter cards.

## Measurement procedure
`T-MEAS-01..06` records startup separately from cycle cost, captures snapshots before and after restart, and compares two finite windows of five identical unchanged cycles using the configured 10% tolerance. The steady-state goal is an explicit band, not an endlessly decreasing sequence. The six-hour cadence supports at most eight fire intervals in a 48-hour observation window (4 fires/day × 2 days); it is not an unconditional eight-cycle ceiling.
